description: This file contains tests for the generated code of some TensorFlow operations, verifying functionalities like placeholders, shape attributes, error handling, and dataset operations.

methods.name: TestPlaceholder
methods.description: Tests the creation of placeholders with different shapes in a TensorFlow graph.

methods.name: TestAddOperationFailure
methods.description: Verifies error handling behavior when a resize operation is provided with an incorrect tensor type.

methods.name: TestShapeAttribute
methods.description: Tests tensor shapes and a simple addition operation, verifying the computation and correctness of tensor values.

methods.name: TestDataset
methods.description: Tests dataset creation and iteration within TensorFlow, ensuring data retrieval and error handling at dataset boundary.
